windows_wasapi.scope: PCM entering output callback to PCM delivered to selected capture callback. Sensor, OSC, renderer and pre-render queue are excluded.
windows_wasapi.uncertainty: At least the sum of observed maximum output/input callback periods plus one sample. Driver timestamp conventions, clock drift, resampling and scheduler delay are uncalibrated; this is not sensor-to-headphone or acoustic latency.

macos_blackhole_short_run.scope: PCM entering output callback to PCM delivered to selected capture callback. Sensor, OSC, renderer and pre-render queue are excluded.
macos_blackhole_short_run.uncertainty: At least the sum of observed maximum output/input callback periods plus one sample. Driver timestamp conventions, clock drift, resampling and scheduler delay are uncalibrated; this is not sensor-to-headphone or acoustic latency.

underrun_scope: Application-observed output callback starvation; no assertion about unreported driver or analog-output failures.
latency_scope: Callback output PCM to selected callback capture PCM only; no sensor-to-headphone measurement. Uncertainty floors are not calibrated confidence intervals.
memory_scope: RSS samples and multiple observation windows are retained. Windows shows a bounded switching envelope; macOS has allocator/residency steps and a failed realtime run. No claim of exactly constant RSS or physical memory locking.
superseded_runs: Windows earlier 30-minute runs with roughly 63 Hz accepted updates do not meet 100 Hz acceptance.
The first corrected-clock Windows run failed because the harness requested a room after EOS; it is not a passing device run.
The intermediate matched-source Windows run was stopped when the macOS QoS candidate was rejected; it is not a completed acceptance run.
An earlier periodic BlackHole signal had an ambiguous correlation peak; only the later broadband result is included.
